title: VacationResponse correctly omits Default (required fields present)
description: VacationResponse in vacation.rs has required fields id: Id and is_enabled: bool, so Default is correctly NOT derived. This is intentional and correct — a default VacationResponse with an empty id and is_enabled=false would not match the RFC's singleton semantics. The #[non_exhaustive] attribute is present and correct. No action needed; this finding confirms the design is sound.
